# Paths - edit these for your environment

```
<github>/
  data/
    activity_tables/        <species>_activity_df.rds, TF motif activity per cell type
    SCENICplus/<species>/   eRegulon_direct.tsv, bin_median_AUC_*.csv
    seurat_objects/         the annotated atlases
  reference_files/atac/
    <species>_tf_names.txt        the transcription factors scored per species
    *__v__turneri_pp.tsv          OrthoFinder one-to-one maps against turneri
```

```{r paths}
# Edit the path below to the directory containing the downloaded data
DATA_DIR <- "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"

REF_DIR <- file.path(dirname(DATA_DIR), "reference_files", "atac")
stopifnot(dir.exists(DATA_DIR), dir.exists(REF_DIR))

SPECIES <- c("gracilis", "turneri", "bifurca", "picta")

scenic_dir <- function(sp) file.path(DATA_DIR, "SCENICplus", sp)
tf_names_f <- function(sp) file.path(REF_DIR, paste0(sp, "_tf_names.txt"))

# gracilis and turneri use the combined atlases
SEURAT_FILES <- c(
  gracilis = "GracilisAtlas_pregnant_non_pregnant.rds",
  turneri  = "TurneriAtlas_pregnant_non_pregnant_juvenile.rds",
  bifurca  = "BifurcaAtlas.rds",
  picta    = "PictaAtlas.rds"
)
seurat_f <- function(sp) file.path(DATA_DIR, "seurat_objects", SEURAT_FILES[[sp]])

ORTHO_FILES <- c(
  gracilis = "gracilis_pp__v__turneri_pp.tsv",
  bifurca  = "bifurca_longest_isoform__v__turneri_pp.tsv",
  picta    = "picta_longest_isoform__v__turneri_pp.tsv"
)
ortho_f <- function(sp) file.path(REF_DIR, ORTHO_FILES[[sp]])
```

# 1. Figure 4B - TF activity across the four species

```{r activity-matrices}
# TF activity: motif enrichment in each cell type's marker peaks, as -log10
# adjusted p-values
activity_dfs <- lapply(SPECIES, function(sp)
  as.data.frame(readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "activity_tables", paste0(sp, "_activity_df.rds")))))
names(activity_dfs) <- SPECIES
```

```{r merge-species}
# One matrix of species_cellType columns, over the motifs scored in all four.
common_tfs <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(activity_dfs, rownames))

merged_df_filtered <- do.call(cbind, lapply(SPECIES, function(sp) {
  d <- activity_dfs[[sp]][common_tfs, , drop = FALSE]
  colnames(d) <- paste(sp, colnames(d), sep = "_")
  d
}))

# Remove the embryonic cell types which are present in only some species
merged_df_filtered <- merged_df_filtered[, !grepl("Embryonic", colnames(merged_df_filtered)),
                                         drop = FALSE]

message(length(common_tfs), " motifs, cell types kept: ",
        paste(sort(unique(sub("^[^_]*_", "", colnames(merged_df_filtered)))), collapse = ", "))
```

```{r fig4b, fig.height=10, fig.width=24}
# Figure 4B: selected TFs across cell types and species, scaled per TF so
# species with different dynamic ranges can be compared.

# match requested TFs to the motif names present, ignoring case
resolveTF <- function(tfs, universe) {
  m <- sapply(tfs, function(t) {
    hit <- universe[tolower(universe) == tolower(t)]
    if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
  })
  if (any(is.na(m))) message("Not in the data, dropped: ", paste(tfs[is.na(m)], collapse = ", "))
  m[!is.na(m)]
}

# Select TFs
selected_tfs <- c("NR5A1","NR5A2","AR","ESRRA","ESRRB","Esrrg","Ppara","NR2F2","LHX9",
                  "Lef1","TCF7L2","IRX3","IRX5","ESR2","WT1","BNC2","NR3C1","NR3C2",
                  "TRPS1","TEAD3","TEAD4","GATA2","GATA3","GATA4","GATA5","GATA6","PGR")
tf_use <- unname(resolveTF(selected_tfs, rownames(merged_df_filtered)))

present_cts <- unique(sub("^[^_]*_", "", colnames(merged_df_filtered)))
desired_cell_order <- c("Endothelial", "Erythrocytes", "Germline", "Germline stem cells",
                        "Immune", "Stromal", "Vascular smooth muscle",
                        "Yolk pericardial sac", "Late follicle cell",
                        "Germinal epithelium", "Theca", "Granulosa")
cellOrder <- c(intersect(desired_cell_order, present_cts),
               setdiff(present_cts, desired_cell_order))

species_colors <- c(turneri = "#377EB8", gracilis = "#E41A1C",
                    bifurca = "#4DAF4A", picta = "#FF7F00")

dot_scaled <- merged_df_filtered[tf_use, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("TF") %>%
  pivot_longer(-TF, names_to = "Full_Name", values_to = "Activity") %>%
  separate(Full_Name, into = c("Species", "CellType"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(TF = factor(TF, levels = tf_use),
         CellType = factor(CellType, levels = cellOrder)) %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  mutate(Scaled_Activity = Activity / max(Activity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(dot_scaled, aes(TF, CellType, colour = Species, size = Scaled_Activity,
                       group = Species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0, 8)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "TF activity, scaled per TF (four species)",
       x = "Transcription factor", y = "Cell type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# 2. Figure 4C - SCENIC+ consensus networks

```{r load-scenic}
# eRegulons and binarised AUC, keeping only +/+ and -/- eRegulons.
all_eRegulons <- list(); auc_binary_list <- list(); tf_lists <- list()

for (sp in SPECIES) {
  message("SCENIC+: ", sp)
  all_eRegulons[[sp]] <- read_tsv(file.path(scenic_dir(sp), "eRegulon_direct.tsv"),
                                  show_col_types = FALSE)

  auc <- read_csv(file.path(scenic_dir(sp), "bin_median_AUC_by_gene.all_cell_types.csv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE)
  colnames(auc) <- gsub("_\\([0-9]+g\\)$", "", colnames(auc))
  auc_binary_list[[sp]] <- auc

  tf_lists[[sp]] <- read_delim(tf_names_f(sp), delim = "\t", col_names = FALSE,
                               show_col_types = FALSE)$X1 %>% gsub("-.*", "", .)
}
```

```{r load-ortho}
# One-to-one orthologues, each species against turneri
get_ortho_map <- function(path, ref_col, target_col) {
  df <- read.table(path, fill = TRUE, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
  df <- df[!grepl(",", df[[ref_col]]) & !grepl(",", df[[target_col]]), ]
  df[[ref_col]]    <- gsub("^g0+", "g", sub("-T[12]", "", df[[ref_col]]))
  df[[target_col]] <- gsub("^g0+", "g", sub("-T[12]", "", df[[target_col]]))
  dplyr::distinct(df, !!sym(ref_col), !!sym(target_col), .keep_all = TRUE)
}

ortho_maps <- list(
  gracilis = get_ortho_map(ortho_f("gracilis"), "turneri_pp", "gracilis_pp"),
  bifurca  = get_ortho_map(ortho_f("bifurca"),  "turneri_pp", "bifurca_longest_isoform"),
  picta    = get_ortho_map(ortho_f("picta"),    "turneri_pp", "picta_longest_isoform")
)
```

```{r load-atlases}
# The atlases, used to require that a TF is expressed where its eRegulon is
# called active.
rna_threshold <- 0.5

atlas_list <- lapply(SPECIES, function(sp) { message("atlas: ", sp); readRDS(seurat_f(sp)) })
names(atlas_list) <- SPECIES

get_expressed_tfs <- function(seurat_obj, threshold = rna_threshold) {
  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seurat_obj, group.by = "ident", slot = "data")$RNA
  as.data.frame(avg_exp) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_raw") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_raw, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "expression") %>%
    mutate(gene_id = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", gene_raw))) %>%
    filter(expression > threshold) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_type, gene_id, expression)
}

pseudobulk <- lapply(atlas_list, get_expressed_tfs)
```

```{r network-params}
# Network thresholds.
rank_cutoff       <- 0.50   # keep links in the best half of triplet ranks
max_cell_types    <- 5      # an eRegulon active in more than this is not cell type specific
eRegulon_count    <- 8      # TFs drawn per cell type
number_of_species <- 1      # species support required
```

```{r network-helper}
# Draw one network.
plot_tf_network <- function(edge_df, active_regs, title_text,
                            tf_species_counts = NULL, is_core = TRUE) {
  if (nrow(edge_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  top_tfs <- gsub("_.*", "", active_regs)

  g <- as_tbl_graph(edge_df, directed = TRUE) %>% activate(nodes) %>%
    mutate(is_top = name %in% top_tfs,
           clean_node_id = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", name)),
           species_supported = if (!is.null(tf_species_counts))
             coalesce(tf_species_counts[clean_node_id], 1) else 1)

  ggraph(g, layout = if (is_core) "stress" else "fr") +
    geom_edge_link(aes(color = factor(regulation),
                       width = (100 - triplet_rank_perc) / 100,
                       alpha = int_with_plot),
                   arrow = arrow(length = unit(2.5, "mm")),
                   end_cap = circle(3, "mm"),
                   show.legend = c(color = TRUE, width = TRUE, alpha = FALSE)) +
    geom_node_point(aes(color = species_supported, size = is_top)) +
    geom_node_text(aes(label = name, size = is_top, alpha = is_top),
                   repel = TRUE, fontface = "bold", family = "sans") +
    scale_edge_color_manual(name = "Regulation", values = c("1" = "#228B22", "-1" = "#CC0000"),
                            labels = c("Activation", "Repression")) +
    scale_edge_width(name = "Confidence", range = c(0.2, 1.5)) +
    scale_edge_alpha_manual(values = c("1" = 1, "0" = 0.3)) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 5, "FALSE" = 2.5), guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.7), guide = "none") +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Species active in", limits = c(1, 4), breaks = 1:4) +
    theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
    labs(title = title_text, subtitle = "Core interactions between the top regulons") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
}
```

```{r rankings-per-species}
# Active eRegulons per species, kept where the TF is also expressed there.
# These inform the consensus
all_rankings <- list(); all_raw_edges <- list()

for (sp in SPECIES) {
  scenic_base <- auc_binary_list[[sp]] %>%
    rename(cell_type = cell_types) %>%
    pivot_longer(-cell_type, names_to = "eRegulon", values_to = "Is_Active") %>%
    filter(Is_Active == 1) %>%
    group_by(eRegulon) %>% filter(n() <= max_cell_types) %>% ungroup()

  active_regulons_long <- scenic_base %>%
    mutate(gene_id = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", eRegulon))) %>%
    inner_join(pseudobulk[[sp]], by = c("cell_type", "gene_id"))

  message(sp, ": ", nrow(active_regulons_long), " active and expressed eRegulon calls across ",
          n_distinct(active_regulons_long$cell_type), " cell types")

  all_rankings[[sp]]  <- active_regulons_long
  all_raw_edges[[sp]] <- all_eRegulons[[sp]]
}
```

```{r consensus, fig.height=24, fig.width=24}
# Figure 4C: every species placed in turneri gene space, so a TF counts once
# however many species support it. Core networks only.
turneri_edges <- all_raw_edges[["turneri"]]

id_to_full_name <- bind_rows(
  tibble(id = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", turneri_edges$TF)),   full = turneri_edges$TF),
  tibble(id = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", turneri_edges$Gene)), full = turneri_edges$Gene)
) %>% distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% deframe()

mapped_rankings <- list(); mapped_edges <- list()

for (sp in SPECIES) {
  rankings <- all_rankings[[sp]]; eReg_raw <- all_raw_edges[[sp]]

  if (sp != "turneri") {
    target_col <- setdiff(names(ortho_maps[[sp]]), c("turneri_pp", "Orthogroup"))
    rankings_m <- rankings %>%
      inner_join(ortho_maps[[sp]], by = setNames(target_col, "gene_id"),
                 relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      mutate(tf_symbol = turneri_pp)
    edges_m <- eReg_raw %>%
      mutate(from_id = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", TF)),
             to_id   = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", Gene))) %>%
      inner_join(ortho_maps[[sp]], by = setNames(target_col, "from_id"),
                 relationship = "many-to-many") %>% rename(from = turneri_pp) %>%
      inner_join(ortho_maps[[sp]], by = setNames(target_col, "to_id"),
                 relationship = "many-to-many") %>% rename(to = turneri_pp)
  } else {
    rankings_m <- rankings %>% mutate(tf_symbol = gene_id)
    edges_m <- eReg_raw %>% mutate(from = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", TF)),
                                   to   = gsub("^g0+", "g", gsub("-.*", "", Gene)))
  }

  mapped_rankings[[sp]] <- rankings_m %>% mutate(species = sp)
  mapped_edges[[sp]] <- edges_m %>%
    mutate(triplet_rank_perc = (triplet_rank / max(triplet_rank, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100) %>%
    filter(percent_rank(triplet_rank) <= rank_cutoff) %>% mutate(species = sp)
}

consensus_activity <- bind_rows(mapped_rankings) %>%
  group_by(cell_type, tf_symbol) %>%
  summarise(mean_scaled_activity = sum(as.numeric(Is_Active), na.rm = TRUE),
            n_species_active = n_distinct(species), .groups = "drop")

consensus_edges <- bind_rows(mapped_edges) %>%
  group_by(from, to, regulation) %>%
  summarise(avg_rank = mean(triplet_rank_perc, na.rm = TRUE),
            species_count = n_distinct(species), .groups = "drop")

for (ct in intersect(FOCAL_CELL_TYPES, unique(consensus_activity$cell_type))) {
  ct_data <- consensus_activity %>% filter(cell_type == ct)

  top_active <- ct_data %>%
    filter(mean_scaled_activity >= number_of_species) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = mean_scaled_activity, n = eRegulon_count, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    pull(tf_symbol)

  if (length(top_active) == 0) {
    message(ct, ": no TFs met the species-support threshold"); next
  }

  counts_lookup <- ct_data %>% dplyr::select(tf_symbol, mean_scaled_activity) %>% deframe()

  core <- consensus_edges %>%
    filter(from %in% top_active & to %in% top_active) %>%
    rename(triplet_rank_perc = avg_rank) %>%
    mutate(int_with_plot = "1",
           from = recode(from, !!!id_to_full_name),
           to   = recode(to,   !!!id_to_full_name))

  p <- plot_tf_network(core, recode(top_active, !!!id_to_full_name),
                       paste0("Consensus | ", ct), tf_species_counts = counts_lookup)
  if (!is.null(p)) print(p) else
    message(ct, ": no core interactions between the top ", eRegulon_count, " TFs")
}
```
